# GigKaro

> GigKaro is India’s pincode-level gig hiring network. We connect businesses with frontline workers who live nearby, and we measure success by one thing: people who actually join.

Work is local. Hiring should be too.

GigKaro is proudly built by EarlyJobs, operated by Victa EarlyJobs Technologies Private Limited. Tagline: Kaam Karo. Kamao.

## About

- [About GigKaro](https://www.gigkaro.in/about/): Full company story, model, values, vision and FAQ
- GigKaro is not a job portal. We don’t sell job posts, subscriptions or candidate databases.
- Success-based hiring: we earn when a candidate successfully joins.
- Coverage across 19,000+ pincodes in India.
- We never sell candidate data. Where API integration is enabled, applications flow Worker → GigKaro → API → employer system.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.gigkaro.in/): Find gig jobs near you across India

- [Blog](https://www.gigkaro.in/blog/): Guides and updates on gig work and local hiring
- [Sitemap](https://www.gigkaro.in/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public URLs

Roles we commonly cover: Delivery, Quick Commerce, Logistics, Warehousing, Retail, Drivers, EV & Mobility, Field Operations.

## Who GigKaro is for

### Workers
Find work near you. No resume needed. Less travel, less friction, more local opportunity. Always free for candidates.

### Businesses
Hire frontline teams in the localities where you operate. High-volume, multi-city, pincode-level, success-based hiring focused on joinings, not more resumes.

### Tech / Ops
Plug into the GigKaro API and get candidates straight into your system where integration is enabled.

### Partners
Build local hiring with GigKaro in your city or pincode.

## How hiring works

Reach → Apply → Engage → Screen → Select → Join

1. Reach relevant workers in the exact location needed
2. Apply simply on any phone
3. Engage the worker with the opportunity
4. Screen and move the right candidates forward
5. Support selection
6. Drive the joining outcome that counts

## What makes GigKaro different

Traditional job portals are job-posting driven, sell posts/subscriptions, focus on applications and broad discovery, and often treat candidate data as a product.

GigKaro is hiring-outcome driven, success-based, joining-focused, pincode and locality-focused, API-first, and treats hiring outcome as the product. Job portals help you find applications. GigKaro helps you get joinings.

## EarlyJobs ecosystem

- EarlyJobs — The Recruitment Network: distributed recruiters for high-volume hiring
- Huntlo AI — AI Hiring Infrastructure: source, engage, screen and hire with AI
- GigKaro — The Gig Hiring Network: frontline execution across pincodes

## Vision and mission

Vision: Build the world’s most accessible local hiring network for the frontline workforce.

Mission: Make good work accessible closer to where people live, while helping businesses build frontline teams faster. More local. More direct. More technology-driven. More outcome-focused.

## Values

- Local first. Good work should be close to home.
- Outcomes over activity. Joinings, not job posts.
- Workers are people. Never products.
- Direct and transparent. Candidates go straight to you.
- Built for scale. One locality or thousands.

## FAQ

- Is GigKaro a job portal? No. We don’t sell job posts, subscriptions or candidate databases. Our model is success-based, tied to joinings.
- How does GigKaro make money? When a candidate successfully joins your company.
- Do you sell candidate data? Never.
- How does candidate data reach employers? Through API integration, where enabled, directly into their system.
- Which roles do you cover? Delivery, quick commerce, logistics, warehousing, retail, drivers, EV and mobility, field operations and more.
- How many pincodes do you cover? 19,000+ across India.
- Who is behind GigKaro? EarlyJobs, operated by Victa EarlyJobs Technologies Private Limited.
